name: Hitsteps
line: Tracks website visitors, journeys, goals, and click heatmaps.

free.text: 7-day Pro trial; Free 1 site, 14-day history, 2,000-view cap unclear

cells.cookieless: Yes, core analytics can run without cookies

pv.math: 10,000 is not under the Starter limit of 10,000, so it falls in Growth, which covers under 50,000. If the limit includes that boundary, Starter at $4.99 could apply instead.
100,000 pageviews is under the Pro limit of 500,000. The monthly base price is $21.99.
1,000,000 is not under the Business limit of 1,000,000, so it falls in Scale, which covers under 12,000,000. If the limit includes that boundary, Business at $49.99 could apply instead.
